scope: Root performed the authorized Pi staging, real one-shot I2C read, systemd drop-in installation and inactive-motor-stack service restart. This independent review inspected fetched receipts and hashes locally; it performed no SSH, service changes or hardware actions.

original_defects.finding: Service repeatedly checked the startup reading; three fake polls produced one sensor read.
Exact3.6/3.4/3.3V cell anchors fell through to100%; reproduced CLI18/17/16.5V all100.
Every critical-voltage poll reissued shutdown +1; three fake polls produced three scheduling commands, and return status was ignored.

correction: One fresh sensor reading after every existing10s poll sleep.
Closed calibration intervals, exact anchors and piecewise interpolation without unnecessary denominator epsilon; five-cell percentage output remains integer.
Shutdown scheduling once per process after command returncode0; failures reported tostderr and retried only on a later low reading.
Hardware imports moved intoCLI after argument parsing; importing utility for tests does not import hardware bindings.

coverage: all calibration anchors and interpolation midpoints

limitations: No physical low-battery or actual shutdown test was performed. Healthy service state does not directly measure individual polling transactions; repeated fresh reads and scheduling decisions were validated with mocks.
Successful subprocess return records scheduling acceptance, not proof that shutdown later occurs.
Once-per-process flag is intentionally not persistent across service restart; existing systemdRestart=always remains unchanged.
No automatic cancellation on voltage recovery; existing shutdown policy retained.
Existing I2C lock busywait, read errors and wall command behavior remain unchanged; this is not a broader battery failsafe redesign.
Native mocked tests used the existing session virtualenv; actual one-shot and installed service used /usr/bin/python3. No claim that the virtualenv test executable itself was the service executable.

post_restart_health.claim_limit: Pinned replacement remained alive beyond two poll intervals with no recorded restart. Its healthy silent journal does not directly establish repeated I2C reads or exercise low-voltage shutdown.

steps: Require motor/control stack inactive; stop battery_monitor.service before replacing its effective executable.
Verify then remove only /etc/systemd/system/battery_monitor.service.d/99-pupper-foundation-20261030.conf; do not use systemctl revert or remove other drop-ins.
Run systemctl daemon-reload and confirm original effective ExecStart and original117708 utility hash match captured backup.
Restore the recorded active/running state with systemctl start battery_monitor.service; preserve enabled state, root user/group and Restart=always.
Inspect status and exact process command line. Do not silently cancel a pending low-battery shutdown.
